Welcome to The Veterinary Channel, where Dr. Radka Busina shares her passion for animal health and wellness through educational videos. As a licensed veterinarian with decades of experience in the field, Dr. Busina is committed to helping pet owners better understand their furry friends and make informed decisions about their care.

From tips on nutrition and exercise to guidance on common health issues and preventative measures, The Veterinary Channel's videos cover a wide range of topics to help you keep your pets happy and healthy. Whether you're a new pet owner or a seasoned pro, our goal is to provide you with the knowledge and tools you need to be the best caregiver you can be.

So if you're looking for reliable, informative content about animal health and wellness, you've come to the right place. 

Disclaimer: These videos are not meant to diagnose medical conditions, consult with your veterinarian for treatment options.
